# OrthoHarness (orthoharness.com)

> OrthoHarness now lives at decisionindex.com. Its orthopaedic check (a topic against the JBJS journals by level of evidence, and an AI answer's DOIs, PMIDs and quotes against PubMed, by fixed rules, in the browser, nothing stored) is the orthopaedic set at https://decisionindex.com/ortho (draft until surgeons write and approve the key). The OrthoHarness name and tool are available to acquire or license (white-label) for orthopaedic device and AI makers validating their AI: https://solvinghealth.com/partners#orthoharness

## Now at
- [go: check an orthopaedic topic or an AI's citations at decisionindex.com/ortho](https://decisionindex.com/ortho)

## Partners
- [license: acquire or license the OrthoHarness name and tool](https://solvinghealth.com/partners#orthoharness)

## Code
- The open harness stays on GitHub (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/blainomd/orthoharness
